Owned/borrowed multiplication, add_ref and owned/borrowed addition; retained product/sum publication and has_arithmetic_reuse_evidence.

prospective_preconditions: Leave the original unsupported opaque-product guard first and unchanged. After that guard, one radical in each operand implies both atom vectors are empty.

A direct branch may handle only exactly one radical per operand, equal Rational radicands and a non-unit radicand. Unequal, unit, zero-width, multiple-radical and opaque cases retain the original general body.
Do not inherit cache-local borrowing, Arc polynomial payloads, scratch storage substitutions, rational-only scaling branches or memo omission.
arithmetic_sequence: Compute the rational-constant product in the original left/right order.
Compute the owned-left radical coefficient times the right rational constant.
Compute the borrowed-right radical coefficient times the left rational constant.
Merge the linear contributions in left-then-right order, skipping addition exactly when the original insertion skips a zero contribution. Remove an exact cancellation.
Compute left radical coefficient times right radical coefficient, multiply that result by the left radicand, then add it to the rational-constant product in the original order.

payload_selection.case: left linear contribution nonzero and combined radical coefficient nonzero
left linear contribution zero and right linear contribution nonzero
payload_selection.retained_radicand: original right radicand payload, even when equal-valued left storage differs

payload_selection.case: both linear contributions zero or cancel exactly
payload_selection.retained_radicand: none; consider releasing the consumed vector instead of retaining unused capacity

ownership_notes: Keep original input scalar owners live through the arithmetic that reads them. Output radicand identity follows insertion behavior and can be checked through the existing storage_identity API without exposing a new public hook.
The owned left radical Vec is a possible output buffer when exactly one radical survives. No persistent field, representation, cache lock lifetime or Computable owner needs to change.

Rational multiply/add operators use retained numeric results. The reviewed reuse admission follows arithmetic observations and stored facts, not Arc strong counts. Operation order and selected payloads still matter for cache behavior; whole-crate equivalence is not inferred from this inspection.
edge_cases: Both nonzero linear contributions, each one-sided zero case, both zero and exact conjugate cancellation.
Equal-valued radicands in distinct storage; shared constants aliased with coefficients and rational parts.
Unit radicands and raw private zero coefficients, internally unreduced ratios, wide integers and dyadics; retain original fallback and observable representation.
Term/radical limits at eight and nine; zero work/depth and mandatory original retry after first-memo drop.
Opaque rejection/ownership release, general unequal-radicand insertion order and unchanged P4 behavior.
qualification_requirement: Shared regression controls should pass unchanged on baseline and candidate. Add differential checks against the original general multiplier plus independent exact examples, selected-payload and buffer/owner controls. Preserve fallback bytes. Qualify scalar default/all features, doctests, formatting, strict Clippy and docs before costs.
cost_requirement: A distinct unchanged-parent baseline and candidate need fresh fixed rational, quadratic and integer probes: five paired blocks, 60 measurements, 12 preflights, 4096 timing inputs and 1000 allocation inputs per phase, builds before probes, every sample retained. Native correctness, original gates, matched endpoint/broad/abort controls, complete reports and production size remain separate retention requirements.
risks: An eligibility comparison can add work on nonmatching inputs and changes when numeric comparison caches are touched. is_one may canonicalize internally unreduced ratios.
Extra dispatch, code growth, changed allocation capacities and shorter temporary ownership can affect costs even when returned values agree.
Coverage cannot establish speedup or resolve any inherited endpoint or scalar tradeoff.
